documents.title: Notice Of 13Th Annual General Meeting Alongwith Annual Report For FY 2025-26

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue growing 144.69% year-on-year to INR 716.38 crores and PAT increasing 46.94% to INR 50.48 crores. The company successfully commenced operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility in Mumbai and is progressing with its upcoming Jaipur facility, which has an allotted capex of INR 47 crores. To support its growth plans and working capital requirements, Shanti Gold has approved a rights issue of up to INR 100 crores. For the full year, management has guided for 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth, targeting a top line of INR 3,500 crores. Shanti Gold International Limited reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching ₹716.4 Cr, representing a 144.7% year-on-year growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top line growth of 50% to 60% and volume growth of 30% to 40% for the current year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: The company is sticking to its estimated revenue target of INR 3,500 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: This rights issue is basically to support the growth trajectory. It is because a new factory has come up, we have – we need to fuel the growth part and all. So that is in line with the target of, estimated target of INR3,500 crores in this year, but yes, in case if we see good demand coming up maybe in the quarter three or something, we are – we can revise our guidance, but as of now we are sticking to the guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects an operating PAT margin of around 4%.
The company expects its EBITDA margin to be around 7.5% to 8% going forward.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin would be around 7.5% to 8%.

guidance.claim: Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the sustainable net profit margin is around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Management expects next year's turnover to be around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores.
guidance.quote: So next year like around we expecting a turnover of around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores and with 35% to 40% growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for organized jewellery in India remains constructive, supported by wedding and occasion-led demand.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: The company witnessed huge demand in both export and local markets following a recent exhibition.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments despite elevated gold prices during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to receive sustained inquiries and repeat purchases from customers.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouragingly, we continue to receive sustained inquiries and repeat purchases from our customers, which provide us with confidence and visibility regarding future business momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: Increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers and retailers is noted as a strong encouraging trend.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has allotted around INR 47 crores of capex for the Jaipur facility, which is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory is spread across 3 acres of land, with the first phase being 50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is awaiting RBI approval for its Dubai office to increase its international footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: In that, I will just add up, because our Dubai factory has just – Dubai office is just coming in which have just done with the compliance patent laws, we are just – in back in India, we are awaiting for the RBI approval.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol factory is almost ready to start in a month or so, while the Jaipur factory should start around September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: A change in inventory method from FIFO to WAC resulted in an unrealized inventory gain of roughly 2% to 2.5% in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: See, there was a change in inventory method from FIFO to WAC method. There was some unrealized gain which was locked in the inventory of last year, which got spilled in this current year. So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses grew to support the company's sales and growth trajectory.
margins_costs.quote: Basically these are expenses which is required to support our sales trajectory, growth trajectory, and this is in line with the growth because if you see the top line it has grown by 144 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: In Q1 FY27, Shanti Gold achieved a gross margin of 10.9% and an EBITDA margin of 10.0%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 10.0% PAT Margin: 7.1%

margins_costs.claim: Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, the company recorded a gross margin of 10.9% and an EBITDA margin of 9.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 9.9% PAT Margin: 6.9%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% as compared to 4.89% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% as compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis pointsY-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization for the existing Mumbai facility is 75%.
The company's existing facility has a capacity of 2.7 tons, while the new facility has started with around 4 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So after our new facility, Jaipur and everything which starts, so you know, we are manufacturing with now with the capacity of 2.7 ton and our new facility which has started with around 4 ton.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's business model involves keeping stock readily available rather than working on an order-to-order basis.
orders_capacity.quote: The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis. So our jewellery stocks are always ready.

orders_capacity.claim: Shanti Gold's installed capacity stands at approximately 6,700 kg per annum across Andheri and Marol post-commissioning.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: The total capacity of the company upon completion of the Jaipur facility will be 7,900 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Total capacity on completion: 7,900 kg pa

orders_capacity.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The present capacity utilization is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares to raise up to INR 100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's current debt-to-equity ratio is 0.50, and it plans to keep it under 1.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: The funds raised from the rights issue will be completely invested in gold and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a steadily deleveraging balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistently improving returns and a steadily deleveraging balance sheet signal strong fundamental momentum

capital_allocation.claim: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to the weighted average cost method.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced negative cash flows due to its business model of keeping ready stock.
risks_headwinds.quote: The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis. So our jewellery stocks are always ready.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company previously exited Gold Metal Loans due to high volatility in gold prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: So earlier also we used to do GML and all, but due to the high volatility, we went on -- we came out from GML.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues and wars have caused the incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary to be extended.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: The company is sticking to its guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth for the year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the Jaipur facility to be operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its EBITDA margin to be around 7.5% to 8% for the year.
management_commitments.quote: But going forward, we don't see that, because the gold is still moving in a narrow band, so we expect the margin should be around 7.5% to 8% EBITDA this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to keep its debt-to-equity ratio under 1.
management_commitments.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Marol factory is going to start in a month or so, and the Jaipur factory should start by around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects export share to go up from 10% to 20% or more.
management_commitments.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve full 7,900 kilos or maybe more in three to four years.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, three to four years, we should achieve full 7,900 kilos or maybe more.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
